thread:
Maria Chen: Quick check — trying to lock the oncall handoff + triage cadence for next quarter. Proposals below, pls react with your preference (1/2/3) and flag blockers.
Maria Chen: Options: 1) Daily 15m triage @ 09:15 — quick rollcall + open incidents. 2) Mon/Wed/Fri 30m deep triage for ongoing incidents + RFC/design slot. 3) Hybrid: daily 5m async roll (thread) + Tue/Thu 30m deep triage.
Maria Chen: Sample rotation snippet to sanity-check alignment: 
```
Mon-Fri:
  Primary: team-alpha-primary
  Secondary: team-alpha-secondary
Weekends:
  Primary: team-alpha-weekend
```
Sanjay Patel: leaning 3 (hybrid). We need to require escalation attendance: infra lead + runtime on-call for any Sev2+. Also add an "owner check" for reopened incidents.
Kelly O'Neill: +1 to hybrid. small ask — can we move start to 09:30 so EU folks aren't in the middle of lunch?
Leo Martinez: If deep triage is twice a week, can we reserve 10m specifically for RFC quick feedback? Otherwise RFC PRs pile up and block releases.
devops-bot: Reminder: rotation change for team-alpha scheduled 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. See /rota for details.
Maria Chen: Good call, Leo — propose RFC quick-feedback as agenda item after open incidents. Draft agenda: 1) Rollcall (2m) 2) Open incidents & status (up to 12m) 3) RFC quick-feedback (10m) 4) Action items + owners (3m).
Sanjay Patel: Attendance list: on-call primary, infra lead, runtime lead, SRE triage, and one engineering owner for any long-running incident. If critical escalation, page exec-oncall.
Kelly O'Neill: I can be backup for escalation on Thu deep triage.
Leo Martinez: tagging @Carla Ruiz for docs and playbooks. Carla — can you own the post-triage notes and update the incident runbook? Also suggest a "stale" label query to sweep old incidents. Link: https://internal.redwood/inbox?q=label:stale-incidents
Carla Ruiz: I can cover Tue/Thu triage. Happy to own notes. Agree on adding stale-incidents query and will add it to the triage checklist.
Maria Chen: Sounds like consensus -> Hybrid (option 3) + shift to 09:30 start and Tue/Thu deep triage with an RFC slot. I'll update calendar and rotation snippet by EOD and add owners. Please reply with :thumbsup: if this works or :thumbsdown: with a short reason.
Kelly O'Neill: :thumbsup:
Sanjay Patel: :thumbsup:
Leo Martinez: :thumbsup:
Carla Ruiz: :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll post updated calendar invite and a short agenda doc in #eng-oncall when done.
